reviews.comment: Dr. Pellois is one of the best professors i've have at A&M. His lectures are very interesting and informative, and he's really funny. His tests are hard, but if you study the slides and the practice tests they're fine. He also allows you to do test corrects for a curve. He is very nice and reasonable.

He's a really funny prof, lectures are really enjoyable and digestible. Test material is more based on slides than the lectures he gave, but he gives so much extra credit and there was a curve at the end of the semester as well.

He's a funny guy but his lectures were honestly not worth going to for me, since he would just draw things on the chalkboard the whole time with no reference to the slides he would post on Canvas. There were lecture recordings from previous years that were more helpful. Exams were pretty difficult but extra credit helped a lot.
He's super funny. Exams are hard but at the end he gave an insane curve. He gives extra credit after every exams and hw are free points. Be prepared to study hard.

Sweet, kind teacher, but the exams are sometimes ridiculously difficult/long. Especially in a 50 minute time span, every student seems prone to having hand cramps by the end from trying to draw out structures/explain their thoughts on open ended questions. He offers 5-10 point corrections on tests depending on class performance. It barely helps :/

Professor Pellois is definitely one of the best profs I've had in three years, he somehow made BIOCHEMISTRY really interesting. He is very animated during lectures, and connects the facts with real world examples. He also emphasizes knowing the ideas rather than the facts, so be prepared to really think about questions he asks. Take him!

I am a junior and of those years Dr. Pellois is one of my favorite professors so far. He does care a lot and he is the only professors that believes mistakes are not set backs but learning curves. He does not curve exams but he allows corrections. He wants to see you do better. Hes also hilarious in class and will specifically tell you what to do.

Dr. Pellois is brutal with his exams. He overarches his lecture material and does not teach what he wants his students to take away, as the lecture material and homework are in no way related to exam material. He is very unapproachable and disdainful when it comes to genuine questions and feedback and then gets upset when no one participates.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Pellois cares a lotabout his students and about the material. His lectures are great, and though attendance isn't mandatory, going to class is definitely worth it. His tests can be hard to prepare for fully, as he likes to cover material not exactly the same way as in class or the homework, so sometimes it's hard to figure out what to study
